aboutPage.whoWeAreDescription1: We are a community of believers aspiring to be an authentic Christian community that glorifies Christ in both proclamation and lifestyle. Though we are not a gathering of perfect people, yet as a community, we believe that we are in the process of sanctification. This is why we strive to devote ourselves to studying Scripture, prayer, fellowship and the sharing of resources.
aboutPage.whoWeAreDescription2: It is our conviction that the church is the steward of the message of the Good News, the only message of hope for fallen humanity. It is through this message that people can gain salvation and have access to a personal relationship with God. It is thus our mission to spread this Good News in every way possible and make peoples disciples of Christ.

intro.page2Subtitle: Join us as we journey together towards a deeper understanding of God's Word and a closer walk with Christ. We are a community dedicated to spiritual growth and mutual support.
intro.page3Subtitle: We are a church committed to proclaiming the Good News of salvation. Through various ministries and outreach efforts, we strive to reach people with the love of Christ.
intro.page4Subtitle: Discover the joy of connecting with like-minded believers. We invite you to join us for inspiring worship, insightful Bible studies, and meaningful fellowship.
